name: 넘어진 물감 선반
prompt:
Cinematic progressive ink-line animation on a solid pure bright white background (#FFFFFF), edge to edge. The very first frame is an entirely empty white field. Static locked-off camera, one continuous 8-second take.

The subjects: one upset student facing a deliberately overturned art shelf while one rude classmate turns away, a cruelly snapped model lying between them, scattered brushes bothering the walkway, a cabinet edge cropped in the foreground, and an enormous tilted shadow shape pressing over the small room like contained anger.

0-3.5s: fine dark-charcoal ink strokes are traced visibly from endpoint to endpoint — each stroke confident, drawn once. The large landscape forms are drawn first with rich observational detail, the main subject last, in a few precise strokes. The composition is asymmetric — the main subject sits off-center. Built progressively, never fading in.

3.5-5.5s: fresh transparent watercolor fills the shapes FROM INSIDE, staying within the ink lines — restrained scarlet on the broken model, deep aubergine on the tilted shelf, cool teal on the student's apron, and warm ochre on the wooden floor. Every color is bright yet softened as true watercolor — no primary crayon colors. One consistent light direction from the upper right, with soft believable shadows. The white background stays pure white.

5.5-8s: the student clenches once then deliberately opens both palms instead of striking; the largest rolling brush stops against a block as the oppressive shadow retreats from the doorway. Everything else stays perfectly still.

Style: fine confident ink drawing with varied line weight and rich observational detail, fresh luminous watercolor, clear summer daylight, cinematic depth of foreground, middle ground and far horizon — the feel of a beautiful illustrated atlas for curious teenagers, never a kindergarten picture book. Museum-quality contemporary illustration.

Never: text, letters, primary crayon colors, muted grey or slate mood, sepia, ink-wash painting mood, fog, smiling sun, V-shaped birds, rainbows, dead-center composition, paint splatter, color outside the lines, camera movement, cuts, dissolve.
